notes: Release build, one real worker, bounded batches of concurrent two-key transactions on disjoint keys, no think time. Latency includes coordinator enqueue, TCP, worker queue, commit and reply. Startup, checkpoint, audit and 16 tail commits excluded from throughput. Recovery measured in Wal::open, excluding process startup; cache is not flushed, order alternates. sync_all durability depends on filesystem/device semantics; SIGKILL is not power loss. No comparison to production databases.
